target.refused: {{ip}} is a local or special-purpose address: the check is not run

notChecked.udpTransport: Not checked: the protocol runs over UDP
notChecked.reality: Not checked: REALITY front (a direct TLS probe tells nothing and risks a block)
notChecked.tunnelTransition: Not checked: the tunnel is connecting or switching
notChecked.geoDisabled: Not checked: geolocation lookups are turned off

dns.systemVsDoh: System DNS ([{{system}}]) does not match public DoH ([{{doh}}]) (possibly split-horizon DNS or a CDN)
dns.googleVsCloudflare: Google DoH ([{{google}}]) and Cloudflare DoH ([{{cloudflare}}]) returned different addresses (GeoDNS/Anycast)

path.noRoute: The routing table returned no active route

pmtu.icmpBlocked: ICMP echo is blocked by the host or the network; showing the network adapter MTU
pmtu.atLeast: PMTU is at least 1500 bytes (the largest tested payload of {{top}}B got through; the exact limit was not measured)
pmtu.range: PMTU within [{{pmtu}} .. {{max}}] bytes (at least {{pmtu}} bytes, larger sizes got no answer)
pmtu.blackhole: Suspected PMTU blackhole: large packets are dropped without ICMP PacketTooBig
pmtu.interfaceOnly: Local interface MTU of {{mtu}} bytes (not a confirmed path PMTU)

geo.rateLimited: The geolocation service rate limit was hit (429). Try again later.
geo.unreachable: Could not connect to the geolocation service.
